scope: CustomerScreen CardPage region and existing production-customer-controls compiled-component tests only

findings.title: Terminal applications re-enter payment or identity collection
findings.before: Latest cancelled/unpaid request offered Complete payment. Withdrawn paid/not_started and refund_pending requests auto-opened identity details; returned paid checkout did the same.
findings.repair: Recognize cancelled/withdrawn/refunded/payment-refunded/issuance-refund-pending before initial auto-open, displayed payment/details branches, provider return, simulated verification, pending resume and details submission. Terminal applications expose status, Notifications/Support and the existing plan picker, subject to unchanged API guards.

findings.title: Withdrawal ignores provider review/confirmation and promises future processing
findings.before: Withdraw caller discarded API result, refreshed request, and always toasted provider-will-process; a failed follow-up read hid successful recorded withdrawal.
findings.repair: Use server message, reviewRequired, refundStatus and returned request. Keep recorded outcome if subsequent application read fails, close stale detail/progress/pending dialogs, show honest unconfirmed/support-review/confirmed copy. Synchronous ref plus busy button prevents two clicks from starting duplicate HTTP requests.

findings.title: Latest refund needs correct kind and current outcome before UI confirmation
findings.before: New caller probe showed a succeeded partial/excess refund could be mistaken for a completed full withdrawal, and failed status could retain stale pending copy.
findings.repair: Read existing /card-request/refund endpoint using owner reference; only full-kind status establishes withdrawal evidence. Succeeded full refund shows confirmed; failed/review-required outcomes show Support guidance. Explicit Check refund status refreshes the existing endpoint; errors remain visible and never claim refund settlement.

files.change: CardPage terminal lifecycle guards, recorded withdrawal result/busy handling, existing refund status read/retry, truthful terminal application/refund states and navigation

Seven compiled-component regressions covering cancelled, withdrawn, refund_pending and refunded states; returned checkout; review-required actual response; duplicate clicks; successful withdrawal/reload failure; confirmed full status; partial refund exclusion; stale pending to failed update

contractsAndRisks: Uses the existing authenticated card request/refund/withdraw endpoints; no new API, money movement helper, provider behavior, schema, dependency or security route change.

Shared CardRequestStatus still omits backend withdrawn/refunded states; parent was notified to correct the shared type separately if authorized. Region compares terminal string states using includes rather than widening an unrelated shared type.

Existing refund GET chooses latest provider_ref entry and returns kind; caller conservatively treats only full refunds as withdrawal evidence and never confirms from a partial/excess status. Missing/full-unconfirmed evidence directs the user to Notifications/Support.
Confirmed means the existing API records provider refund status succeeded or the application is explicitly refunded; real provider settlement is not independently exercised by this UI worker.
Real browser responsive/keyboard/actual API integration, final whole-web tests/build and independent review of this worker-authored repair remain parent-owned.
